SELECT SUM(crash_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(session_count), 0) AS crashRate, SUM(crash_count) AS totalCrashes, SUM(session_count) AS totalSessions FROM performance_summary WHERE app_key = #{appKey} AND province IS NULL AND app_version IS NULL
AND date >= DATE(#{startTime})
AND date <= DATE(#{endTime})
AND hour IS NOT NULL
AND hour IS NULL

SELECT SUM(lag_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(session_count), 0) AS lagRate, SUM(lag_count) AS totalLags, SUM(session_count) AS totalSessions FROM performance_summary WHERE app_key = #{appKey} AND province IS NULL AND app_version IS NULL
AND date >= DATE(#{startTime})
AND date <= DATE(#{endTime})
AND hour IS NOT NULL
AND hour IS NULL

SELECT (SUM(network_request_count) - SUM(network_failure_count)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(network_request_count), 0) AS successRate, SUM(network_request_count) AS totalRequests, SUM(network_failure_count) AS totalFailures FROM performance_summary WHERE app_key = #{appKey} AND province IS NULL AND app_version IS NULL
AND date >= DATE(#{startTime})
AND date <= DATE(#{endTime})
AND hour IS NOT NULL
AND hour IS NULL

SELECT province, SUM(active_users) AS userCount, SUM(crash_count) AS crashCount, SUM(anr_count) AS anrCount, SUM(crash_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(session_count), 0) AS crashRate, COALESCE(AVG(avg_startup_time), 0) AS avgStartupTime, COALESCE(SUM(network_request_count) - SUM(network_failure_count), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(network_request_count), 0) AS networkSuccessRate, COALESCE(SUM(network_failure_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(network_request_count), 0), 0) AS networkFailureRate, COALESCE(SUM(lag_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(session_count), 0), 0) AS lagRate FROM performance_summary WHERE app_key = #{appKey} AND province IS NOT NULL
AND date >= DATE(#{startTime})
AND date <= DATE(#{endTime})
GROUP BY province ORDER BY userCount DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT date AS time, SUM(crash_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(session_count), 0) AS crashRate, SUM(active_users) AS activeUsers, SUM(lag_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(session_count), 0) AS lagRate, COALESCE(AVG(avg_startup_time), 0) AS avgStartupTime FROM performance_summary WHERE app_key = #{appKey} AND province IS NULL AND app_version IS NULL
AND date >= DATE(#{startTime})
AND date <= DATE(#{endTime})
GROUP BY date ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT app_version AS version, SUM(active_users) AS userCount, SUM(crash_count) AS crashCount, SUM(anr_count) AS anrCount, SUM(crash_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(session_count), 0) AS crashRate, SUM(anr_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(session_count), 0) AS anrRate, COALESCE(AVG(avg_startup_time), 0) AS avgStartupTime, COALESCE(AVG(avg_cpu_usage), 0) AS avgCpuUsage, COALESCE(AVG(avg_memory_usage), 0) AS avgMemoryUsage, COALESCE(SUM(network_failure_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(network_request_count), 0), 0) AS networkFailureRate, COALESCE(SUM(network_request_count) - SUM(network_failure_count), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(network_request_count), 0) AS networkSuccessRate, COALESCE(SUM(lag_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(session_count), 0), 0) AS lagRate FROM performance_summary WHERE app_key = #{appKey} AND app_version IS NOT NULL AND province IS NULL
AND date >= DATE(#{startTime})
AND date <= DATE(#{endTime})
GROUP BY app_version ORDER BY userCount DESC
